about_seo_description: Where {{siteName}} gets the Quran text, translations, tafsir, recitations and fonts: named, published sources, never AI-generated.

about_report_body: If you find a mistake in the Quran text, a translation, a tafsir or a recitation, please tell us by opening an issue on GitHub. Say which verse, and which translation, tafsir or reciter, it affects.
